scenario: LUNI.9.1 — a unit-preserving aggregation keeps the slot's dimension. `mean(r.temp)` on a celsius-typed series has dimension `temperature`; the compare against `25_kilogram` (mass) fires the LUNI.8.2 cross-dimension check with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s `luni_9_1_agg_type`, then `adjacent_mismatches`.
rules_ds:
use default

unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    temp: celsius mutable

series Reading.temp:
    mean sliding 10_s

rule bad:
    Reading r where mean(r.temp) > 25_kilogram
->
    log info "never"
